_note: Read by scripts/gen-credits.mjs to build Credits → Code contributors from `git log` of the repositories below. `aliases` folds every commit name (and Co-authored-by name) one person used into one row; matching is case-insensitive. An optional `emails` list folds commits made under any other name with those addresses (names that share an email are folded anyway; a repository's .mailmap is honoured). `github` is optional when the person commits with a GitHub noreply address. `contributor` is the id of their card in frontend/assets/contributors.json, when they have one. `ignore` drops bots and tools (tested against the name and the email; emails are never written to the output). A repo's `url` is shown as a link: leave it null for a private repository.
